label: Two or more edits since the last test run, past half the budget
reason: The agent has stacked at least two file edits on top of each other without running the tests, and more than half of the step budget is already gone.
nudge: You have changed the code twice since your last test run and you are past half your budget. Run the tests now and read the failure before editing again.
citation: Fires earlier than the built-in submit_without_verify, which only sees the pending submit.
doc: Example rule plugin. Fields: id, severity, when (safe expression over the prefix-feature dict plus the aliases steps_frac / tokens_frac / edits_since_test / max_steps / harness_policy), label, reason, nudge, action_hint. The expression is evaluated by an AST whitelist, never by eval().
